notes.title: 🌟 Defendópolis - Beta Release Now Live! 🌟
notes.content:
📢 Defendópolis - Beta Version Now Available! 📢
We are thrilled to finally release the Beta version of Defendópolis to our community! 🎉 This is your chance to experience the game before the full release.




🔍 What to Expect in this Beta Version:

    Full gameplay experience with the first 10 waves of enemies.
    3 types of enemies with unique abilities and challenges.
    A robust tower-building system to defend your village.


💡 What We Need from You:

Share your impressions, report bugs, and provide suggestions for improvements.


Join the discussions on our Steam Community to help us create the best possible version!




⚙️ What's Next?

    New enemies, towers, and balance tweaks in future updates.
    Continuous improvements based on your feedback for an even more thrilling experience.



🔗 Join our journey, become a defender of Defendópolis, and help us improve the game!


We greatly appreciate everyone who joins us from the start. Let’s build the future of Defendópolis together! 🚀
